name: GMV Winlet 575
summary: Compact, fully hydraulic, self-propelled glazing robot that lifts and places windows and glass panes of up to 575 kg with a vacuum lifting frame, steered from a cable control unit. Made by GMV A/S in Denmark.

germany.statusNote: GMV A/S (Bredsten, Denmark) sells Winlet glazing robots direct and has German-language product pages with a quote form and phone line. The Winlet range starts at EUR 24,600 ('Wir bieten Winlet ab: EUR 24.600'); which model this applies to and whether it is net is not stated. No German dealer is named.

sellers.name: GMV A/S
sellers.note: Office and production: Industriparken 1, DK-7182 Bredsten. German quote form on the product page; demonstrations on request. Range price 'ab EUR 24.600' on the Winlet overview page, model not stated.

specs.label: Maximum load
specs.quote: Winlet 575 Fensterroboter ist der kleinste der voll hydraulischen Fensterroboter mit Traglast bis 575 kg.

specs.label: Hydraulic functions
specs.conditions: load side-shift and load rotation are standard
specs.quote: hat der Winlet 575 sechs hydraulische Funktionen

specs.label: Gyro function
specs.conditions: keeps the glass in the same position while the crane arm lifts

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: terrain tyres, front-axle drive, fully hydraulic movements
specs.quote: Winlet Verglasungsroboter haben Geländefähige Bereifung mit Vorderachsantrieb

specs.label: Control
specs.value: cable control unit with vacuum on/off at the frame; one-person operation
specs.quote: So können Sie Vakuum vorne an der Traverse ein- und ausschalten, was eine 1-Mann Handhabung und Glass Installation mit einem Winlet ermöglicht.

specs.label: Other materials
specs.value: granite, tiles, gypsum and gypsum-fibre boards, concrete elements, aerated concrete, wood panels, steel sheets, fire doors
specs.quote: Der Winlet 575 ist so für Handhabung von Granit, Fliesen, Gipsplatten & Fasergips, Betonelemente, Porenbeton, Holzplatten, Stahlbleche und Brandschutztüren einsetzbar.

notes: Remote-operated lifting machine, not autonomous: the operator steers and places the load with a cable control unit.
Vacuum lifting frame on a hydraulic crane arm with fully linear frame movement, used e.g. to fit panes into pre-installed frames (maker).
GMV says Winlet tyres are terrain-capable with front-axle drive; slope and ground limits are not stated for this model.
Battery capacity, runtime, weight and dimensions are in the maker's catalogue PDF, which could not be read.

evidence.task: Lifts and places glass panes and windows, e.g. into pre-installed frames
evidence.note: Maker says it has been the preferred window robot of professional glaziers and rental companies for years.
